name: asomiya
description: Write, check and run programs in Asomiya, the programming language in Assamese.
long_description: Asomiya (অসমীয়া) is a programming language whose keywords are Assamese words, written in Assamese script or in English letters. This extension lets Claude write, check, run and explain Asomiya programs, look up keywords and error codes, show programs in Python, and teach lessons — with a playground right in the chat. Programs run in a sandbox: they can't touch your files, the network or the system.

tools.name: run_asomiya
tools.description: Run an Asomiya program and show its output.

tools.name: check_asomiya
tools.description: Check a program for syntax errors without running it.

tools.name: asomiya_to_python
tools.description: Show the same program in Python.

tools.name: lookup_keyword
tools.description: Look up keywords and built-ins in any script.

tools.name: explain_error
tools.description: Explain an error code and how to fix it.

prompts.name: teach_asomiya
prompts.description: A short, hands-on lesson on one topic.
prompts.text: Teach me ${arguments.topic} in Asomiya, explained in ${arguments.language}.

prompts.name: translate_to_asomiya
prompts.description: Rewrite a program in Asomiya and check it runs.
